A '''blind Arobernos'''<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> resided on the [[planet]] [[Mustafar]]. The giant's [[eye]]s were squeezed shut, preventing it from being able to see. It was pained by being locked in [[symbiosis]] with the [[spider]]y [[Eye of Webbish Bog]]. When [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] encountered the two creatures while searching for [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] [[Sith wayfinder]], he guessed that the giant was under the control of the Eye of Webbish Bog, but could not survive without it.<ref name="Expanded Edition" />
